两个头，两对手，两对胸: 2 heads, 2 pairs of arms, 2 pairs of breasts
头、躯干、手臂、腿的形状来自 VRoid Studio 旧版的女性素体（CC0）: The shapes of the head, torso, arms, and legs come from the old female base body of VRoid Studio (CC0). The body shape is made by stretching her original form wider, narrower, thicker, or thinner: shoulder width, waist width, hip width, and limb thickness can all be adjusted, and build changes all of these together. Hip width only affects the standing pair of human legs (it doesn't change with a centaur, arachne, one-legged body, or three or more legs per pelvis). Gender and hand style have no effect on her.
带头发、衣服和贴图的现成角色，上面「角色」里选是哪一个。多出来的头、手臂、胸是把: A ready-made character with hair, clothes, and textures; pick which one under "Character" above. Extra heads, arms, and breasts are copies of her own parts attached to her, and the pieces simply overlap each other instead of being fused; tails, wings, horns, animal ears, the centaur's horse body, and the arachne's spider body are separately made single-color parts. With legs set to "Humantaur", "Tandem", or "Gather at pelvis", the extra legs are copies of her own pelvis and legs (skirt and shoes included) attached to her (with "Gather at pelvis", each pelvis sits tightly against the next and the legs spread outward); with "Side by side", or with three or more legs per pelvis, the middle section of her pelvis (the inner sides of the two thighs plus the crotch) is copied as is several times and laid out in a row. With several upper bodies, everything above her waist (hair, clothes, and arms included) is copied whole and bent outward to both sides from the waist, and the copies overlap each other at the waist. Every body shape setting except "Build" can be adjusted: shoulder width, waist width, hip width, limb thickness, and arm length stretch her body and clothes directly, and if you push them far, the patterns on the textures will warp along with them.
几种发型是从别的现成模型上取下来的头发（pixiv 以 CC0 发布的 VRoi: Several of the hairstyles use hair taken from other ready-made models (VRoid samples released by pixiv under CC0), swapped onto her head as a whole; the extra heads change along with it. Hair color is applied by dyeing, while hairpins, ribbons, and highlights stay as they are. With several heads, first click one head under "Dye which head" to dye only that one (animal ears follow it), or click "All" to dye all the heads together. Length only affects the part hanging below the tip of the nose.
戴的是和成品角色同一批现成的头发，转成了没有颜色的白模，和头融合成一整块；多出来: The hair worn here is the same ready-made hair used by the ready-made characters, converted into a colorless base mesh and fused with the head into one piece. Each extra head wears its own set, and horns and animal ears grow outside the hair. The base mesh has no color, so hair color only works with the ready-made character. Length only affects the part hanging below the tip of the nose.
